methodology: V3 - untuned LLaMA-3.1-8B in 4-bit NF4, strategy_c tokenizer resize (128256->8000) with token-aware embedding remap applied. Direct HuggingFace causal LM forward pass on filtered validation set (pathD_v2_filtered/validation_shared_v3.jsonl), single-GPU sequential eval, no LoRA wrapping.
source: Direct eval 2026-07-28 during Phase 3 audit. Discovered V2 baseline was ~67% inflated relative to direct measurement, likely due to QLoRA-wrapped evaluation methodology introducing adapter noise.

v1.note: Original baseline, deprecated when V2 was introduced. Close to V3 within ~4%.

v2.methodology: V2 - QLoRA-wrapped LLaMA-3.1-8B, seq_len=1024, trainer.evaluate() pathway
v2.note: May 2026 attempt to 'correct' V1. Discovered in July 2026 to be ~67% inflated. Likely cause: LoRA adapter contribution to loss even when untrained. Deprecated in V3.
